title: ECP Review Adjudication (owner decision record)
description: The human/owner review seam (M3-CA0, 0.3.0): one record per explicit OWNER decision on an open review question. Adjudications are INPUTS to the review engine: a re-run consumes them and records the decision inside the affected open questions. The engine never fabricates, infers, or defaults an owner decision; without an adjudication record the question stays open. disposition semantics: RESOLVE-CLEAN = question resolved, no longer blocks eligibility; ACCEPT-RISK = owner explicitly accepts the recorded risk, no longer blocks eligibility (recorded as accepted); CONFIRM-DEFECT = the underlying finding is confirmed as disqualifying (candidate REJECTED mechanically); UPHOLD-OPEN = question explicitly kept open (still blocks). adjudication_hash = SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of this document with the top-level adjudication_hash field removed.

owner_identity.description: Identity of the owner whose decision this record carries (the decision authority; the operator only transcribes).

recorded_by_operator.description: Operator identity who transcribed the owner decision into the review area (attribution of the transcription, not of the decision).

at.description: When the owner decision was communicated (owner-asserted; an input, not evidence).

applies_to.description: Scope of the decision: a question code (optionally restricted to one candidate).

question_code.description: Open-question code this decision resolves (e.g. 'OQ-NOV-EXTERNAL'). Without candidate_id: applies to every candidate carrying that code.

rationale.description: The owner's stated rationale (transcribed verbatim; free text).

adjudication_hash.description: SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of this document with adjudication_hash removed.
